_notes: Bathon: Saint Bathon (Bathan) is an obscure Irish/Scottish monk; no standard Catholic Chinese transliteration found — provisionally rendered 巴同. Birgitte of Sweden: Chinese Catholic uses 比尔吉特 (Birgitta) or 彼济大; 比尔吉特 used here (provisionally). Blasius: 布拉斯 is common Catholic zh (St. Blaise). Bruno: 布鲁诺 is standard (St. Bruno of Cologne). Cæcilia (Cecilia): 则济利亚 is 思高/Catholic zh standard. Cœlestinus I: 策肋斯定 is Catholic zh (Celestine). Callistus: 加利斯多 is Catholic zh. Castulus: 卡斯图禄 (provisional). Christina: 克里斯蒂娜 (provisional transliteration). Chrysogonus: 克理索弄 (provisional). Clara: 加辣 is standard 思高/Catholic zh (St. Clare). Clement Maria Hofbauer: 克莱孟·玛利亚·霍夫鲍尔 (provisional). Conradus a Parzham: 帕尔查姆的康纳德 (St. Conrad of Parzham; provisional). Cunegundis: 孔尼贡德 (St. Cunegunde/Kunigunde; provisional). Damasus: 达玛苏 is standard Catholic zh (Pope Damasus I). Deusdedit: 德乌斯德 (provisional transliteration of this unusual name). Didacus: 狄达谷 is used in some Chinese Catholic sources; confirmed. Dionysius/Denis of Paris (with Rusticus and Eleutherius): standard pairing — 狄奥尼削 for Dionysius, 卢斯提格 for Rusticus (provisional), 厄勒特利 for Eleutherius. Dominic: 道明 is locked (glossary §10). Donatus: 多纳托 (provisional). Dorothea: 多罗特亚 (provisional). Eduardus/Edward the Confessor: 厄杜阿尔多 (provisional Catholic zh for Edward). Eleutherius (Pope): 厄勒特利 (Eleutherius; same as Denis companion, provisional). Elisabeth of Portugal: 依撒伯尔 matches glossary (Elisabeth=依撒伯尔). Emerentiana: 厄默冷 (provisional). Emygdius: 厄米基 (Emygdius of Ascoli; provisional). Ephraem Syrus: 厄弗冷 used by 信德 and Catholic sources (圣厄弗冷); matches 艾弗冷 / 厄弗冷 pattern. Erasmus: 厄拉斯莫 (St. Erasmus/Elmo, bishop and martyr; provisional). Eugenius IV: 尤金尼四世 (Pope Eugene IV; note: not a saint in the modern calendar but appears in 1960 Breviary context; 尤金尼 provisional). Eusebius: 欧瑟伯 per glossary §6. Eutychianus: 厄弟基亚诺 (Pope Eutychian; provisional). Evaristus: 厄瓦里斯托 (Pope Evaristus; provisional). Felix of Cantalice: 坎塔利切的斐理斯 (Felix=斐理斯, per pattern of Philip=斐理伯; Felix more precisely 斐理斯 / 费利斯 — 斐理斯 chosen for Catholic register). Felix de Valois: 瓦卢瓦的斐理斯 (Felix of Valois; Valois=瓦卢瓦, provisional). 'almæ Urbis' = sanctified city = 圣城 (referring to Rome). 'dioecesis Monacensis' = 慕尼黑教区 (Munich diocese). 'Patroni principalis Civitatis Archiepiscopis' = 总主教城市首要主保. Canute (Canuti): 克努托 = standard transliteration of Canute/Knut; used 克努托 here. Chrysogonus: 克理索弄 is provisional; some sources use 格黎索各诺.
